item.title: CVE-2026-110927 · 4.3 MEDIUM — Openssh: openssh: a compressed payload can expand past the maximum packet size
item.description: A flaw was found in OpenSSH. After compression is negotiated, a compressed payload can expand past the maximum supported packet size because the inflate loop does not stop at that limit. Memory use grows in the process handling that connection.

item.description: A flaw was found in OpenSSH. When compression is negotiated, channels on the same connection share one LZ77 dictionary. A peer who can write on one channel can recover plaintext from another channel by chosen-plaintext lengths.

item.description: A flaw was found in OpenSSH. A username entered on the ssh command line can still contain '$' or a non-trailing backslash. When a configuration expands %u inside ProxyCommand or Match exec, those characters are passed into the shell.

item.description: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost vhost-crypto. Integer overflow in chain length checks, and missing length checks on the RSA path, can overflow a host buffer in the vhost-crypto backend.

item.title: CVE-2026-86856 · 6.5 MEDIUM — Dpdk: dpdk: stack and heap buffer overflow in nfp vdpa driver

item.description: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost vhost-crypto. Write-back chain cleanup can follow an uninitialized next pointer when mapping a guest descriptor fails, causing the host vhost-crypto process to hang or crash.

item.title: CVE-2026-86846 · 6.5 MEDIUM — Dpdk: dpdk: guest can trigger out-of-bounds write by controlling avail ring index in vhost-crypto
item.description: A flaw was found in DPDK lib/vhost vhost-crypto. A guest can supply an avail-ring descriptor index that is used without bounds checking, causing an out-of-bounds write in the host vhost-crypto backend.
